messages:
Asha_CS: Quick FYI — Heliogen asked to shorten their upcoming renewal from 12mo to 6mo. They're requesting a 15% ARR discount in exchange for a product case study and logo placement. Procurement insists invoice & PO must come from Heliogen UK Ltd (different billing entity). Need to confirm price and signer.
Tom_Rev: do we have current ARR/seat counts and baseline renewal price?
Asha_CS: Current ARR = $120k/year, 24 seats. Renewal baseline (12mo) quote was $120k. If we go 6mo pro rata, list would be $60k; with 15% discount that's $51k. They'll sign an amendment + PO from UK.
Kevin_Fin: UK entity ok but we need VAT reg # before issuing invoice. Also finance requires PO reference on the invoice and Net30 terms. Who will sign for Heliogen UK?
Sophie_Legal: If invoice goes to Heliogen UK, sig needs authority from that entity. Legal needs a copy of the delegation of signing authority or an email from their GC. Also will review a short amendment to change term and price — can you drop a draft?
Asha_CS: dropping draft amendment below:
```
Amendment: Term shortened to six (6) months; Total fee $51,000; Payment: Net30 upon invoice receipt; Billing entity: Heliogen UK Ltd; PO required. All other terms unchanged.
```
Tom_Rev: Looks fine. Approve on renewals side if Finance/legal sign-off. Can we offer a one-time onboarding credit of $2,500 to offset prorate friction? Thoughts?
Kevin_Fin: credit ok if Rev approves; include credit on invoice line item and show net amount. We still need VAT number and PO before processing payment.
Sophie_Legal: I'll run a quick redline — if they provide a PO and delegation email we can approve the amendment without full countersignature loop. Otherwise need exec sign-off.
Asha_CS: @docusign-bot can you create an envelope with the amendment + SOW link, signers: Heliogen UK CFO and Redwood Revenue Ops lead?
Docusign-bot: Created envelope 0a9f... Link: https://docusign.example.com/envelopes/0a9f - status: awaiting recipient
Tom_Rev: I'll be Redwood sig once legal clears. @Kevin_Fin please confirm invoicing code so we can map to PO when it arrives.
Kevin_Fin: GL code 5202-RENEW. Send PO and VAT reg # to finance@redwood.ai
Asha_CS: I'll chase customer for delegation email and PO today. Will update thread with doc and envelope status. :thumbsup:
Tom_Rev: thanks — marking as action: get PO + VAT + delegation email. If those arrive by EOD tomorrow we can get this across the line before month-end.
Sophie_Legal: noted. If something stalls, fallback is to invoice Redwood EU reseller and handle revenue share — but that needs partner ops; prefer direct if possible.
Asha_CS: noted. will escalate if no PO by tomorrow.
